# Anandhan S - Developer Portfolio

> Anandhan S is an AI & Data Science Engineering student, Full Stack Developer, and Machine Learning practitioner specializing in React.js, Node.js, Python, TensorFlow, PyTorch, and modern web application development.

## About
Anandhan S builds intelligent web applications, computer vision quality assessment systems, and scalable full-stack platforms. He focuses on combining sleek modern UI design with robust backend machine learning models.

## Key Projects
- [SMART COIR](https://github.com/Anandhan88/COIR): AI-powered quality assessment and computer vision processing system for coir fiber manufacturing.
- [GeoGuard AI](https://github.com/Anandhan88/GeoGuard-AI): Real-time spatial hazard detection, geospatial analytics, and disaster management dashboard.
- [Brain Tumor Detector](https://github.com/Anandhan88/Brain-Tumor-detector): Deep learning MRI classification model built with PyTorch, Flask, and React.
- [AARAA INFRA](https://github.com/Anandhan88/AARAA-INFRA): Modern infrastructure management & client request platform.
- [URL Shortener](https://github.com/Anandhan88/URL-Shortener): High-performance microservice with analytical tracking and custom link generation.
